name: Schuman EUROP
oneLiner: EUROP is Schuman Financial's MiCA-licensed euro stablecoin, redeemable 1:1 and backed by euro cash at EU banks with an additional reserve buffer.
collateral: Euro cash and cash equivalents held at EU banks including Société Générale, with an additional 2% reserve fund

mintAuthority.summary: EUROP Ethereum has 3 active MINTER_ROLE holders: an EOA (also DEFAULT_ADMIN), a 3/3 Safe, and an OFT bridge contract owned by a 2/4 Safe. Polygon and Avalanche share the same owner Safe (3/4). XRPL issuer has master key disabled. Plasma chain RPC unreachable.

controls.label: EUROP token owner Safe (ETH, Avax, Polygon)
controls.evidence: EUROP owner() on Ethereum confirmed this Safe at block 25295047. owner() on Avalanche (0x8835a2f66a7aaccb297cb985831a616b75e2e16c) returned same address. Polygon owner (0x888883b5f5d21fb10dfeb70e8f9722b9fb0e5e51) returned 0x29e6fb2dd01455472da3dd962c16a37de096b8da (SafeL2) with same 4 owners and threshold 3 via getOwners()/getThreshold() RPC. Avax Safe confirmed via api.safe.global: threshold 3, 4 owners [0x1bCd423f, 0xf362066e, 0x7dFE41D6, 0x7d8806a9], no modules, v1.4.1+L2.

controls.label: EUROP ETH/Polygon EOA DEFAULT_ADMIN + MINTER_ROLE
controls.evidence: At block 25295047: hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, 0xe3997860) = true; eth_getCode = no bytecode (EOA). Also holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE on ETH. Same address holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and MINTER_ROLE on Polygon per RoleGranted logs. No RoleRevoked events on ETH.

controls.label: EUROP ETH direct minter Safe (3/3)
controls.evidence: Confirmed GnosisSafeProxy via Blockscout. At block 25295047: hasRole(MINTER_ROLE) = true. getOwners() returned 3 owners [0x70d16d28, 0xc963533b, 0xc5285950]; getThreshold() = 3; getModulesPaginated returned empty array (no modules); guard slot = zero.

controls.label: EUROP ETH OFT bridge MINTER_ROLE (EUROPOFT)
controls.evidence: Identified as EUROPOFT (LayerZero OFT bridge) by Blockscout. At block 25295047: hasRole(MINTER_ROLE) = true. owner() returned 0x04b4cb9d5a8417729231221a8ef22a1d06adb32b (GnosisSafeProxy, 2/4 Safe with owners [0x5379b2b5, 0x1cf1804b, 0xd0ed9bd2, 0x3f433019]).

review.evidence: ETH: 3 active MINTER_ROLE holders confirmed (EOA, 3/3 Safe, OFT bridge owned by 2/4 Safe). Owner Safe (3/4) confirmed on ETH, Avax, and Polygon.
